title: Fine Phase-Tuning of 20-Layer Alternating Stack with Tightened Bounds
scientific_hypothesis: The 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 topology discovered in round 1 is near-optimal, but thickness values require fine phase-tuning within ±8 nm of emergent peaks/troughs to lock onto resonant optical path lengths without disrupting the established alternating pattern.
design_principle: Reduce optimizer mutation step size and tighten thickness bounds around the best-performing candidate from round 1 to transition from coarse period-discovery to fine phase-tuning, allowing the solver to refine optical path lengths while preserving the verified alternating topology.
proposed_topology: Air | (HfO2 | SiO2) × 10 | Fused Silica substrate - exactly 20 finite layers in alternating sequence
design_variables: 20 layer thicknesses with bounds centered on round-1 best candidate values, ±8 nm tolerance
manufacturing_considerations: Total layer count fixed at 20 (within 30-layer constraint)
Thickness bounds tightened to ±8 nm for deposition control feasibility
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for planar multilayer optimization
Quarter-wave stack building block principle with non-quarter-wave fine-tuning
expected_advantages: Reduced search space improves optimization efficiency
known_risks: May be trapped in local optimum if initial bounds are too restrictive
±8 nm tolerance may not capture global optimum if emergent pattern is suboptimal
execution_request_english: Optimize a 20-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 multilayer stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (20 finite layers total). Initialize thicknesses at [110, 56, 117, 58, 122, 61, 130, 58, 149, 59, 154, 65, 132, 113, 115, 131, 121, 111, 59, 58] nm based on round-1 best candidate. Set optimization bounds to ±8 nm around each initial value. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with reduced mutation step size. Evaluate spectral performance at normal incidence across 300-450 nm (maximize reflectance) and 1000-1700 nm (maximize transmittance). Apply ±5% relative thickness tolerance for robustness analysis. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: Maximum total layer count of 30.
revision_reason: Refinement of route_01 per feedback directive: tightened thickness bounds to ±8 nm around emergent peaks/troughs from round-1 best candidate, reduced mutation step size for fine phase-tuning while preserving verified 20-layer alternating topology
